<!-- Source page: Wlsunset -->

[wlsunset](https://sr.ht/~kennylevinsen/wlsunset/) is a service that adjusts screen temperature and gamma adjustments depending on time of day. It works specifically with Wayland compositors supporting `wlr-gamma-control-unstable-v1`.
